## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), certifying the
      [Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org/).
- [ ] No code copied from QZ Tray or from projects whose license is not approved (see CLAUDE.md).
- [ ] Tests cover the change; `npm run lint`, `npm run check`, `npm test`, `cargo clippy` and
      `cargo test` pass.
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, README, CHANGELOG) when behavior a user or a page can observe changes.
- [ ] UI text added to both `locales/en.json` and `locales/es.json`.
